title: 第一卷 第5章 男女授受不亲第一卷 第6章 什么竟然要她负责
slug: 笨蛋美人当团宠师兄们抢疯了
content_zh:
;;
舒晩昭生得好看，唇色粉红，娇艳欲滴，在说话时会露出洁白的贝齿和若隐若现的舌尖，坐着的沈长安看得一清二楚。
他就静静地看着，不知想什么。
任由她叫嚣，甚至还在她口干舌燥之际，递过去一杯水。
舒晩昭一愣，惊疑不定地瞅他两眼，两只小手乖乖地接过杯子，喝两口润润唇，然后继续"嚣张跋扈"。
这一次，系统没有在她脑子里吱声，应该很满意她的表现吧？
舒晩昭内心忐忑地等着这位人面兽心的大师兄命人抽死自己。
等啊等。
终于，他开口了。
“冥顽不灵。”
对，就要这么骂，然后让人把她拖走鞭打，她就可以名正言顺记恨上他，然后再想办法弄瞎他的双眼。
舒晩昭做好被拖出去的准备。
却听他缓缓道：“过来。”
那声音温柔，犹如招呼小猫小狗似的，看不出丝毫生气的预兆。
“啊？”她面露不解，不是应该拖出去鞭打吗？
难不成他要亲自动手？
她磨磨蹭蹭过去。
他又道：“伸手。”
她对这个男人怕到骨子里，本能地听话。
然而下一秒，就见他如玉的手指不知何时执起一根戒尺，毫无情面地打下。

一切发生的太快，快得连系统“疼痛转移”都没来得及开启，她掌心瞬间红肿起来。
舒晩昭在家被捧在手心里，性格也乖乖的，从未挨过打，对疼痛更是无法忍受。
她疼得呼吸一窒，下意识要撤回手。
却被攥紧了指尖。
男人眼睛都不眨，戒尺再次狠狠落下。
整整十下，她没办法挣脱，哭得上气不接下气，眼睛和鼻尖红红的，下唇几乎被咬出血，豆大的泪珠大颗大颗落下，从小巧的下巴滴落，挣扎间，落在了男人的手背上。
他动作一顿，捏紧她的指尖。
逼问：“疼吗？”
“疼……”其实后面几下已经被系统转移了，可是刚开始那两下她是自己生生挨的，疼死她了。
“不过区区皮肉伤，怎抵得过魔气带来的伤痛？”
挨完戒尺还要挨鞭子，舒晩昭不敢吱声，哽咽地吸鼻子。
大概是看出她知道教训了，沈长安放下了戒尺，指腹轻轻揉了揉她的掌心。
“师兄确实有责任保护你，但你要记得，保护你，并不意味别人要为你牺牲性命，人的生命是平等的，你并没有比他高贵在哪，自己要作死，就不要牵连无辜的人，明白了吗？”
“明白了。”
她点头，泪珠还停在睫毛上，漂亮的脸蛋哭起来梨花带雨，眼神也雾蒙蒙的楚楚可怜。
他多看两眼，收了手，从储物袋里拿出一小瓶消肿止痛的药膏，塞入她完好的那只手里。
“退下吧，从明日起，每日挥剑一万次，我亲自监督，没有筑基在院子里待着不许出去。”
什么？
舒晩昭下意识问：“你不拿鞭子抽我？”
沈长安：“？”

他诧异地抬眸：“在师妹心里，师兄会这般待你。”
是的，明明你就是抽了女配啊。
舒晩昭磨磨蹭蹭不愿意离开，直到看见他又要拿戒尺，心里咯噔一下，呲溜一下就跑了。
独留沈长安看着她的背影，微微摩挲了一下指腹。
上面，残留着细腻的触感。

Shu Minzhao was good-looking, with pink lips and delicate lips. When he spoke, he would reveal his white teeth and looming tip of his tongue, which Shen Changan could clearly see while sitting.
He just watched quietly, not knowing what to think.
He let her yell and even handed her a glass of water when her mouth was dry.
Shu Minzhao was stunned, looked at him in confusion, took the cup obediently with his two hands, took two sips to moisten his lips, and then continued to be "arrogant and domineering".
This time, the system didn't chirp in her head. She should be very satisfied with her performance, right?
Shu Zhaozhao waited anxiously for this senior brother with a human face and an animal heart to order him to be whipped to death.
Wait and wait.
Finally, he spoke.
"Stubborn."
Yes, she would scold her like that, and then have her dragged away and whipped, so that she could justifiably hate him, and then find a way to blind him.
Shu Mingzhao was prepared to be dragged out.
But I heard him say slowly: "Come here."
The voice was gentle, like greeting a kitten or puppy, without any sign of anger.
"Ah?" She looked confused. Shouldn't he be dragged out and whipped?
Is it possible that he wants to do it himself?
She dawdled over.
He added: "Reach out your hand."
She was afraid of this man to her core and instinctively obeyed him.
However, the next second, his jade-like fingers were seen holding a ruler at some point, and he knocked it down mercilessly.
Everything happened so fast that the system's "pain transfer" didn't even have time to activate, and her palms instantly became red and swollen.
Shu Mingzhao was held in the palm of his hand at home and had a good-natured personality. He had never been beaten and was even more intolerable to pain.
She choked in pain and subconsciously wanted to withdraw her hand.
But it was clenched tightly at the fingertips.
The man didn't blink, and the ruler fell hard again.
For a full ten times, she couldn't break free and was out of breath from crying. Her eyes and the tip of her nose were red, and her lower lip was almost bleeding from the biting. Big tears fell down, dripping from her small chin, and fell on the back of the man's hand during the struggle.
He made a move and squeezed her fingertips.
Pressed and asked: "Does it hurt?"
"It hurts..." In fact, the next few blows had been transferred by the system, but the first two blows were suffered by her, and they hurt her to death.
"How can a mere flesh wound be worth the pain caused by the demonic energy?"
After being beaten with the ruler and whipped, Shu Manzhao did not dare to say anything and sniffed with sobs.
Probably seeing that she had learned the lesson, Shen Changan put down the ruler and gently rubbed her palm with his fingertips.
"Senior brother indeed has the responsibility to protect you, but you must remember that protecting you does not mean that others have to sacrifice their lives for you. Human lives are equal. You are not nobler than him. If you want to die, don't involve innocent people. Do you understand?"
"Got it."
She nodded, with tears still on her eyelashes. Her beautiful face was filled with tears when she cried, and her eyes were misty and pitiful.
He took a second look, put his hand away, took out a small bottle of anti-swelling and pain-relieving ointment from the storage bag, and stuffed it into her good hand.
"Stay back. From tomorrow onwards, you will swing your sword ten thousand times a day. I will personally supervise you. You are not allowed to go out in the courtyard without building a foundation."
What?
Shu Mingzhao asked subconsciously: "Aren't you going to whip me with a whip?"
Shen Changan: "?"
He raised his eyes in surprise: "In Junior Sister's heart, Senior Brother would treat you like this."
Yes, you obviously picked the female partner.
Shu Minzhao hesitated to leave, until he saw him trying to pick up the ruler again, his heart skipped a beat, and he ran away.
Shen Changan was left alone to look at her back and lightly rubbed his fingertips.
On it, a delicate touch remains.
